name: P-H3-Image — text to image
title: Make a large, detailed picture
summary: Describe the picture in detail and P-H3-Image paints it at 4 megapixels in 8 steps. Strong at photos, film looks, posters and short written words. Its prompt writer does not run on this machine yet, so write the full description yourself.
description:
Pruna's P-H3-Image: an image model made from MiniMax H3, the film model, run here as a LoRA on H3.

It renders long, precise descriptions best: write the subject, the setting, the light, the lens and the look, and put any words to be written in quotes. It draws in 8 steps, without a negative prompt, at about 4 megapixels.

It comes with a prompt upsampler (a Qwen3.5-9B writer) that turns a one-line request into such a description, for the aspect ratio you pick. On this ComfyUI build that writer fails (a bug in the Qwen 3.5 decode, the same one that stops the other prompt improvers), so it is off.

It loads the 20 GB H3 model and its text encoder, so the first picture after another card is slow.

promptGuides.label: P-H3-Image — prompting (Pruna)
promptGuides.tip: A one-line request is enough: the prompt upsampler writes the full prompt. Put any words to be written in quotes.

author: Template - ComfyUI

exposedParameters.label: Prompt — describe the whole picture in detail
exposedParameters.default: view through the spokes and rim of an out-of-focus bicycle wheel in extreme foreground, overlaying a sunlit courtyard, whitewashed wall and wooden gate in the midground, two children running past a line of drying sheets, terracotta pots and a lemon tree at the edge, blown-out hazy backlight with oversized golden bokeh orbs, rainbow light leaks across the upper corner, cinematic framing, natural daylight, vintage film aesthetic Absolutely no text, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, pure imagery only.
